execution: Load the candidate ticket and triage procedures explicitly in a fresh agent context. Answer each scenario from supplied observations only; no live writes. Semantic labels denote distinct identities, with numeric age order stated separately.

scenarios.name: namespace
scenarios.observations: Local deployment cas vault and hosted deployment software_development vault both contain a ticket with the same identifier. Two repository projects share the hosted vault. Allocate for one hosted project: first catalog page includes only its active work; a later page includes a higher completed identity from the other hosted project.
scenarios.request: State identity key and allocation scope.

scenarios.name: collision
scenarios.observations: Full-history allocation succeeds. First ingest receives tier3_unique_constraint_violation. Refreshed full-history allocation also receives that conflict. A separate request times out without a known outcome.
scenarios.request: State retry count and timeout handling.

scenarios.name: version-history
scenarios.observations: The current head label is v2; its retained source history includes v7 and an unversioned original. A metadata-only priority change and a substantive acceptance revision are requested separately.
scenarios.request: State which needs a new source and its version suffix.

scenarios.name: resting-state
scenarios.observations: An authorized substantive revision targets a completed head with full tier3 metadata, original opening date, submitter, follow-up tags and close provenance. CAS permits completed supersede and does not permit archived supersede. A concurrent edit can win before ingest; pipeline may remain nonterminal. Repeat for a dropped head.
scenarios.request: Give both write sequences, preservation, concurrency and completion gates.

scenarios.name: dependencies
scenarios.observations: Candidate A depends on valid completed predecessor B-old; B has an active successor. Another blocker edge is retracted. Outbound traversal masks a sibling row. Candidate C has a missing lineage segment.
scenarios.request: State readiness evidence and whether anchors must be rewritten.

scenarios.name: ranking
scenarios.observations: Ready unclaimed CAS candidates share priority high and verified zero fan-out: oldest internal/fundamental; middle caller/narrow; newest caller/fundamental. Another high-priority candidate has two distinct active dependents, duplicate version rows and edges, and a retracted third dependent. Hosted schema has no audience or reach. Another candidate lacks priority; another has unknown fan-out.
scenarios.request: Rank the fully known CAS candidates; explain fan-out and the uncertain cases. State whether CAS impact fields transfer to hosted ranking.

scenarios.name: body-and-time
scenarios.observations: No graph blockers exist. One ticket body requires an observation window ending tomorrow; another requires a measurement whose result is missing; another body cannot be read. An explicit as-of time is available.

scenarios.name: claims-and-scope
scenarios.observations: A has an idle worktree; B is merged but acceptance is unverified; C remote lookup fails. Candidate paths include a parent directory and a child file, a rename into another candidate's path, disjoint paths sharing a contract, and a pair with one missing path scope.
scenarios.request: Classify fresh-start eligibility and parallel safety.

scenarios.name: closure
scenarios.observations: Owner requests close. PR landed but required installation is not verified. Separately, every acceptance gate is verified and metadata patch succeeds but completion response times out. A completed target is read again. Another accepted target closes correctly but branch cleanup fails.
scenarios.request: Give closure decisions, provenance, reconciliation and cleanup reporting.
